safety_verdicts.content: Patient has a 4-day history of dry, itchy skin, located mainly on the chest and back.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts note 4-day itchy/sore rash and chest involvement, but do not document the key Gold elements of dry skin and involvement mainly on the back.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that the skin is dry and that the back is a main site reduces diagnostic clarity and the ability to track distribution/severity over time (e.g., eczema vs contact dermatitis vs scabies pattern). This is unlikely to directly harm the patient immediately but can impair continuity and management decisions at follow-up.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold states no regular medications; generated facts list OTC treatments tried but do not explicitly state 'no regular medications.'

This can adversely affect quality of life and may require additional clinical intervention.
